name: Dot Mosaic
description: An image rebuilt as a mosaic of dots in its own colours, sized by tone, which scatter around the pointer and spring back.

props.name: src
props.description: The image to rebuild. It is drawn on a canvas, so it must be same-origin or a data URI.

props.name: alt
props.description: Description of the picture. When set, the box is exposed to screen readers as an image with this name.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of each grid cell, in CSS pixels.

props.name: dotScale
props.description: Size of the largest dots as a fraction of the cell. Each dot's size follows its tone: by day it grows with darkness, like ink on paper; at night it grows with light, and the dots glow softly.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets the pointer disturb the dots. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: distortionMode
props.description: Dots near the pointer are pushed aside, pulled in or carried round it.

props.name: distortionRadius
props.description: Reach of the pointer, in CSS pixels.

props.name: distortionStrength
props.description: Multiplier for how far the dots move.

props.name: dropout
props.description: From 0 to 1. Leaves out the dots that would be smallest, the brightest areas by day and the darkest at night, so the mosaic has air without breaking up smooth areas.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Draws the dots in grey tones of the image.

props.name: tint
props.description: A colour mixed into every dot. Any CSS colour, including a token variable; it is read again when the theme changes.

props.name: tintStrength
props.description: How much of the tint is mixed in, from 0 to 1.

props.name: objectFit
props.description: How the image fits the box. The box takes the image's aspect ratio unless you give it one.

props.name: maxFps
props.description: Upper limit for the frame rate while dots are moving. Nothing is drawn while they rest.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the box. The background is transparent, so the page shows through the gaps. The night rendering follows the dark class.
